claim_scope.NP_certificate: nonnegative firing vector f with 0<=x-Delta*f<d; f_u+1<=(N-1)^(2N-2), O(N log N) bits per coordinate
claim_scope.dynamics: ordinary asynchronous conservative chip firing, every vertex fires at its actual outdegree, unit output on every outgoing arc, no sink
claim_scope.graph: finite loopless simple strongly connected digraph, N>=2, plus oriented subclass
claim_scope.halting: existence of a legal finite word reaching any stable configuration; least action supplies arbitrary-schedule equivalence without fairness
claim_scope.hardness: deterministic polynomial-time many-one reduction from explicitly encoded 3-CNF; numerical total chips polynomial in source length, hence also unary hardness
claim_scope.input: arbitrary nonnegative integral configuration encoded in binary
claim_scope.restriction: specified root deletion leaves an acyclic graph with no directed two-arc path
